name: return_immediately
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once. It is referenced from a table of handler pointers and is also called by unnamed routines.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no data manipulation or hardware access. Other routines call it directly.

name: return_from_stub
description: The routine is a single return instruction. It is called by several unnamed routines and referenced from a pointer table, so it acts as an empty hook.

name: exit_without_action
description: The routine performs only a return instruction and no other operations. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: clear_buffer_from_pointer
description: The routine stores a pointer taken from a global variable into a field of the global state block. It then zeroes 115 consecutive bytes starting at that pointer.

name: clear_flagged_table_entries
description: The routine resets a 16-bit global counter to zero, then scans a 115-entry table from its last index down to zero. It zeroes each entry whose flag bit 32 is set and skips the rest.

name: clear_entry_and_decrement
description: The routine reads an index byte from the object passed to it. If the table entry at that index has flag bit 32 set, it decrements a 16-bit global counter, then zeroes that table entry.

name: forward_single_call_and_return
description: The routine makes one call to another routine and then returns. It has no logic of its own beyond that delegating call.

name: dispatch_flagged_records_and_clear
description: The routine reads an index from the object. If the table bit is clear, it calls the handler of every record whose flag bit 4 is set, walking eight-byte records up to a limit, then clears the table entry. If the bit is set, it decrements a 16-bit counter and clears the entry instead.

name: run_timed_object_update
description: The routine calls the handler of each record attached to the object, then decrements a 16-bit countdown held in the object. When the countdown expires it updates a global accumulator from a table entry and resets fields, otherwise it calls an indirect routine from the global table.

name: call_table_pointer_return_one
description: The routine calls a function pointer stored at a fixed offset in the global table and returns a 64-bit value whose high 32 bits are 1 and whose low 32 bits are the D1 register input.

name: set_ready_flag_and_notify
description: The routine calls an indirect routine from the global table and sets bit 1 in an object flag byte. If the object's state byte is minus one, it calls a second table routine, and it returns the value 1.

name: process_object_state
description: The routine checks a flag byte against a value in the global state block and, when they match, updates a table lookup, a linked-list pointer and a global counter. It calls a handler when a counter overflows.

name: return_stack_parameter
description: The routine returns the 32-bit value passed to it on the stack unchanged. It acts as an identity function for one argument.

name: initialize_object_defaults
description: The routine calls a table routine, and when its flag is clear it stores a 16-bit argument in an object field and invokes a second routine. It then writes default values into several object fields and calls a further routine.

name: search_object_slot_list
description: When the object's state byte is minus one, the routine compares a table value against a limit in the global block. If the value is in range, it walks a list of short values to locate a matching slot, calling helper routines.

name: extract_flag_from_mask
description: The routine calls a table routine repeatedly to obtain a bit index until the corresponding bit is set in the object's 32-bit mask. It then sets that bit in a second mask and clears it from the first.

name: add_table_value_to_counters
description: When its word argument is below a fixed limit, the routine clears a per-object index byte and a 32-bit field. If the object state byte is minus one, it adds a global word-table value to three 16-bit global counters and calls two helpers.

name: reset_index_and_add_counters
description: The routine clears a per-object index byte and a 32-bit field. If the object state byte is minus one, it adds a global word-table value to three 16-bit global counters and then calls a helper.

name: apply_table_adjustment_and_call
description: If the object's index byte is nonzero, the routine sets it to 1 and, when the state byte is minus one, adds a table value reduced by four to three global counters. It then calls a table routine when the state byte is minus one.

name: find_negative_slot_and_decrement
description: Scans a 30-entry signed table from its end for the first negative value. It decrements the matching slot in a second table and increments a global counter. It calls table routines when the object's state byte is minus one and returns 1.

name: ramp_object_values_toward_target
description: Moves a 16-bit value toward a stored target by a fraction of the difference, one thirty-second or one sixty-fourth depending on a flag bit, and clamps it at the target. It also applies flag-dependent adjustments to other object fields.

name: tick_timer_and_reset_fields
description: Decrements a 32-bit timer field and returns while it is still running. On expiry it resets the timer, then either adjusts counters or sets a flag and calls a table routine depending on a comparison, and finally clears three fields.

name: consume_counter_or_set_flag
description: If a counter byte is nonzero, the routine decrements it, increments a global counter and adds to the timer field. Otherwise it sets bit 1 of a global flag byte, calling a table routine if the bit was clear. It then clears three fields.

name: decrement_counter_or_clear_fields
description: If a counter byte is nonzero, the routine decrements it and adds to the timer field. Otherwise it clears three object fields.

name: set_flag_and_call_handler
description: The routine sets bit 1 in a global flag byte and calls a function pointer from the global table if that bit was previously clear. It then clears three consecutive 32-bit values in the object.

name: tick_timer_apply_table_value
description: Decrements a timer field and returns while it stays positive. On expiry it reloads the timer, decrements two counters and calls a routine. Depending on comparisons it may clear a per-object index byte and add a table value to three global counters, then calls a further routine.

name: reload_timer_apply_table_value
description: Reloads a timer field, decrements two counters and calls a routine. Depending on comparisons it may clear a per-object index byte and add a table value to three global counters, then calls a further routine.

name: clear_index_add_table_value
description: If the object's index byte is nonzero, the routine clears it and a 32-bit field. It then adds a global word-table value to three 16-bit global counters and calls a routine.

name: compare_counter_and_apply_table
description: Calls a routine and compares its low byte with a counter. If the value is not greater, it returns. Otherwise it applies the same index-clearing and table-addition step and calls a further routine.

name: conditional_apply_table_then_call
description: Calls two routines and applies a table-based adjustment to three global counters when a condition holds, clearing the object's index byte. It then calls a final routine.

name: dispatch_stored_record_handler
description: If the stored index word is nonzero, the routine stores a value and calls the handler at a fixed offset in the eight-byte record that index selects. Otherwise it stores the reset value and returns.

name: reset_index_word
description: Stores a constant into the index word of the global block and returns. One unnamed routine calls it.

name: lookup_scaled_table_value
description: Maps an input value to an entry of a global word table, choosing the index shift from three input ranges. It returns the table entry scaled by a shift that depends on the range.

name: initialize_record_table
description: Clears a state field and stores two sentinel constants in global fields. It fills a table of eight-byte records with handler routines and the global data pointer, sets the table limit to 136, and calls each record's init handler in turn.

name: initialize_and_iterate_table
description: Sets two sentinel global fields and clears others, then loops five times over the eight-byte record table, calling each record's handler on every pass.

name: process_bit_two_flag
description: Clears some bits in a flag word and calls the handler of each record whose flag byte is nonzero. It works out how many fixed-size intervals have elapsed since a stored counter and calls the flagged records' handlers for them, then scans a state buffer, clearing bit 2 where its entry is set.

name: call_handler_if_active
description: Walks the eight-byte record table and, for each record whose flag byte is nonzero, calls the handler stored at a fixed offset within that record.

name: dispatch_key_to_matching_record
description: When bit 1 of a flag word is clear, the routine obtains a value from another routine and searches the record table for an entry whose stored byte matches it. A match invokes that record's handler; with no match it calls a fallback routine.

name: call_handler_by_bit_mask
description: Chooses a bit position from the input value using a small comparison chain, then calls the handler of each eight-byte record whose flag byte has that bit set.

name: update_pseudo_random_state
description: Updates two 32-bit global state words by XOR with a constant, rotations, shifts and addition, in the manner of a pseudo-random generator step. It stores the new state back into the global block.

name: advance_state_and_scale
description: Advances two 32-bit global state words with rotations and addition, then multiplies the low word of the new state by its high word and returns the 32-bit result.

name: scale_input_by_state
description: Multiplies the low word of its input by a value derived from the global state words and returns the product with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

name: negate_64_bit_value
description: Calls another routine to obtain a 64-bit value and returns its two's complement, propagating the borrow from the low word into the high word.

name: multiply_signed_32_bit
description: Multiplies two 32-bit operands using 16-bit partial products and carries, adjusting the sign of the result as needed, and returns a 64-bit product.

name: perform_32x32_multiplication
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products and carries. It returns a 64-bit result whose high word also carries a bit derived from the partial sums.

name: compute_fixed_point_loop
description: Derives two 16-bit values through helper calls and stores their difference and a zero field. It then runs a loop of about 61 steps that shifts 32-bit accumulators bit by bit to form a fixed-point result.

name: set_shifted_mask_fields
description: Stores several field values in the global block, each formed by shifting a value left by a count of 63 (minus one masked to six bits).

name: accumulate_scaled_vector
description: Scales three 16-bit values from a structure by a factor taken from another field, shifts the 32-bit products right over a loop of 61 steps, and adds the three results into 32-bit accumulator fields with carry.

name: normalize_and_double_result
description: Counts how many times its input can be shifted right before it reaches zero, calls another routine, then shifts the 64-bit result left by that count and returns it.

name: shift_left_by_normalization
description: Counts the right shifts needed to bring its 32-bit input to at most 32767, calls another routine, and shifts that 64-bit result left by the same count.

name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls another routine and returns its 64-bit result with each 32-bit half negated separately.

name: multiply_signed_fixed_point
description: Negates its argument when it is negative, then shifts the value right to fit a 16-bit range before multiplying. The result is returned as a 64-bit value.

name: multiply_fixed_point_shifted
description: Multiplies two inputs through a shifted fixed-point path and returns a 64-bit result. It combines 16-bit partial products with carry bits from the sums.

name: multiply_after_normalizing
description: Shifts its input right until it fits in 15 bits while counting the shifts. Small values are multiplied directly; otherwise it calls another routine and shifts that 64-bit result left by the count.

name: multiply_and_round
description: Multiplies two 16-bit signed values through 16-bit partial products and carries, then shifts each 32-bit result right by one bit and carries the low bit back in, returning a 64-bit value.

name: accumulate_64_bit_result
description: Calls another routine for a 64-bit value and adds its two 32-bit halves, with carry, into several 32-bit accumulator fields of the global block.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines in succession and then returns. No other operations are performed in this routine.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines in succession and then returns. No other operations are performed in this routine.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines in succession and then returns. No other operations are performed in this routine.

name: fetch_table_entry
description: Returns the 16-bit value at a global base pointer plus an offset passed in a register.

name: set_global_pointer_fields
description: Stores two values into fixed fields of the global block and returns.

name: set_fields_to_global_address
description: Stores the address of a global variable into two fixed fields of the global block and returns.

name: register_table_slot_if_free
description: If a global flag byte is clear and a 16-bit counter is below 248, the routine writes the counter into a byte table and a word table entry, then advances the counter by four.

name: register_slot_return_word
description: Writes the current counter into a byte table slot and a word table entry, advances the counter by four and returns the stored word. When the counter is 248 or more it returns zero.

name: write_byte_and_index
description: Writes a byte at a computed buffer position and stores a combined 16-bit value into the next array slot, then advances the write pointer by four.

name: exit_at_once
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: check_bounds_then_call
description: Tests two values against limits of 319 and 167, calling a helper to refine each one and returning early if a limit is exceeded. It then calls a final routine.

name: call_single_routine_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The routine performs no other operations.

name: check_bounds_then_call_helpers
description: Calls a helper and returns early if its result exceeds 319 or a stored value exceeds 167. Otherwise it repeats the checks, calling helpers, and then makes a final call.

name: check_limits_then_call
description: Calls a helper and returns if its result exceeds 319 or the second value exceeds 167. Otherwise it calls a final routine.

name: apply_flag_bits_and_notify
description: Reads a flag word from the object. When bit 128 is set it updates flag bits in the object and a global flag word and calls an indirect routine. When bit 8 is set it applies similar flag changes and calls a further routine.

name: set_flags_and_call
description: Sets bits 8 and 4 in a global flag word, stores 2 in an object byte, sets bit 32 and clears bit 64 in another object byte, then calls an indirect routine.

name: set_flag_bit_and_call
description: Sets bit 4 in a global flag word, stores 2 in an object byte, sets bit 32 and clears bit 64 in another object byte, then calls an indirect routine.

name: clear_flag_and_add_counter
description: If bit 1024 is set in an object word, the routine clears that bit and adds four to one of two counters, chosen by the object state byte. It then sets a value in an object byte, adjusts object flag bits, calls two routines and sets bit 16 in a global flag word.

name: add_counter_and_call_routines
description: Adds four to one of two counters chosen by the object state byte, sets a value in an object byte, adjusts object flag bits, calls two routines and sets bit 16 in a global flag word.

name: increment_counter_and_notify
description: Adds four to one of two counters chosen by the object state byte, sets a value in an object byte, adjusts object flag bits, calls two routines and sets bit 16 in a global flag word.

name: call_if_value_in_range
description: When a 16-bit value is below 79 and two values differ, the routine calls a helper and, if its result is below 18, calls a further routine.

name: update_table_entry_state
description: Looks up a byte in a per-slot table indexed by a 16-bit value and uses it to update object state. A series of checks on counters and bounds comes first, and the routine calls seven helper routines.

name: apply_indexed_table_effect
description: Extracts a 4-bit index from a flag byte and looks up a table value, then calls a helper. For small indices it adds the table value times eight to a counter; otherwise it scales a counter by a table value and stores a shifted result.

name: accumulate_scaled_counter
description: Calls a table routine, then multiplies two 16-bit values and shifts the product by a count from a global table. It adds the result to a counter, saturating at the maximum, and returns the counter shifted right by four after one more routine call.

name: set_flag_and_compute_offset
description: Sets bit 8 in an object flag byte, then computes a 32-bit product of object fields, adding a further product when another field is nonzero, and passes the result to a helper.

name: set_flag_select_fields
description: Sets bit 16 in an object flag byte, then selects two field values according to the sign of a global word. It derives a position from them with two helper calls.

name: compute_weighted_field_sum
description: Computes a value as a product of object fields, adding a second weighted product when another field is nonzero. It stores a sentinel value of minus one in a field and calls a helper.

name: reset_object_state_and_call
description: Returns early when a global counter is zero. Otherwise, if a flag bit or a routine result allows, it clears six object fields, sets the state byte to 11 and a timer value to 92, and calls helper routines.

name: exit_immediately_no_op
description: Returns at once and performs no operations.

name: clear_slot_set_flag_bit
description: Reads a byte from a per-slot table indexed by a 16-bit value. If it is nonzero and a condition fails, the routine clears it and, when a global index matches the object's index, sets bit 4 in a global flag word and calls helper routines.

name: set_state_and_copy_text
description: Increments a counter in the object and sets its state fields, then copies a zero-terminated string from a global buffer into an object buffer. The string is chosen by a flag bit and a sub-type value.

name: copy_text_and_call_helper
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from a global buffer into an object buffer, sets two object fields, and calls a helper when the object's type byte matches a fixed character value.

name: update_state_return_minus_one
description: Calls a table routine. When the object state is 11 and a value is below 40, it stores that value and an index. It stores the object index, clears a field, calls routines and returns minus one.

name: call_then_return_minus_one
description: Calls one other routine and returns the constant minus one.

name: add_signed_fixed_values
description: Adds three 32-bit values from its arguments to three 32-bit fields of the object, propagating sign extension and carry into the next word of each field.

name: match_index_against_slot_table
description: Uses a register index to choose a 16-bit limit from a set of fixed globals, with a fallback value for unmapped indices. It compares a second register against that limit, sets a status global and may return early.

name: match_index_and_set_status
description: Shares the index-to-limit selection of its neighbours, then compares the chosen limit with a register value and sets a status global to the matched index.

name: compare_limit_and_set_status
description: Selects a 16-bit limit by register index from fixed globals and compares it with the supplied value. The result sets a status global, and the routine returns early when the value is below the limit.

name: load_indexed_limit_value
description: Selects a 16-bit limit by register index from fixed globals and loads it for the caller, following the same index-to-limit mapping as its neighbouring routines.

name: check_slot_index_range
description: Tests a register index against the valid range and returns early when it falls outside it. Otherwise it reads the matching limit from fixed globals.

name: dispatch_slot_index_handler
description: Selects one of several fixed globals by register index and performs the corresponding comparison and status update, calling a helper for indices outside the mapped set.

name: store_index_word
description: Stores a 16-bit register argument into one of several global words, chosen by a register index. The indices 35 and 36 and the range 5 to 13 each select a different global.

name: store_index_word_with_fallback
description: Selects a global word from the register index, using a default word for unmapped indices, and stores a 16-bit argument into it. It returns early when a required flag is clear.

name: select_limit_stage_one
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_two
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_three
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_four
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_five
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_six
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_seven
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_eight
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: select_limit_stage_nine
description: One stage of a chain of similar routines. It picks a 16-bit limit from fixed globals, starting from its own link, and returns early when the caller's value is below it. Otherwise it writes the value to a global selected by the register index.

name: store_first_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_second_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_third_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_fourth_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_fifth_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_sixth_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_seventh_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_eighth_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: store_ninth_slot_and_clear
description: Stores a value into one fixed global. When a status global is clear and two neighbouring globals are zero, it also zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data.

name: dispatch_index_slot_check
description: For register indices below 18, compares the index against four stored globals and performs a slot-specific action on a match. It calls helper routines for the other cases.

name: set_index_default_first
description: Sets a global to 32000 for index 14 and to smaller defaults for indices 15 to 17, returning early for other indices. It then runs the common clear-and-store step.

name: set_index_default_second
description: Sets a global to a default value for indices 15 to 17 and returns early for any other index. Matching indices continue into the common clear-and-store step.

name: set_index_default_third
description: Sets a global to a default value for indices 16 and 17 and returns early for any other index. Matching indices continue into the common clear-and-store step.

name: set_index_default_fourth
description: Sets a global to a default value for index 17 and returns early for any other index. A match continues into the common clear-and-store step.

name: set_index_default_switch
description: Chooses among four default globals with a switch on the register index, setting one of them, then runs the common clear-and-store step.

name: set_index_default_tail_one
description: Sets one global to a default for index 16 and then runs the common clear-and-store step, returning early for other indices.

name: set_index_default_tail_two
description: Sets one global to a default for index 17 and then runs the common clear-and-store step, returning early for other indices.

name: set_index_default_tail_three
description: Sets one global to a default when the index is 17 and returns early otherwise, with a conditional clear-and-store step after it.

name: clear_block_store_first_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when two status globals are clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_second_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when two status globals are clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_third_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when two status globals are clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_fourth_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data under a status condition. It sets a flag byte to 255 when another flag is set, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_fifth_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when a status global is clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_sixth_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when a status global is clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_seventh_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when a status global is clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_eighth_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data unconditionally, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: clear_block_store_ninth_index
description: Zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data when a status global is clear, then stores the register index into several globals.

name: route_value_to_matching_handler
description: Compares a global value against four fixed globals and calls the routine assigned to the matching one. The routine calls one of four routines depending on which global matches.

name: clear_block_after_flagged_call
description: Sets a status global to 1, calls a routine, and then zeroes a 32-byte block in the global data. Further steps follow in the same routine.

name: set_status_and_store_value
description: Sets a status global to 1, stores the register argument in a second global and sets a third global to 64, then returns.

name: set_status_two_and_store
description: Sets a status global to 2, stores the register argument in another global and clears a routine pointer, then returns.

name: validate_argument_range_then_set
description: Sets a status global. When its argument is zero or above 64, it clears the status and returns; otherwise it stores values into several global fields and calls seven helper routines.

name: select_channel_pointer_first
description: Chooses a destination pointer and a small code value from global flags and a counter, then calls helper routines.

name: select_channel_pointer_second
description: Chooses a destination pointer and a small code value from global flags and a counter, then calls helper routines.

name: select_channel_pointer_third
description: Chooses a destination pointer and a small code value from global flags and a counter, then calls helper routines.

name: select_channel_pointer_fourth
description: Chooses a destination pointer and a small code value from global flags and a counter, then calls helper routines.

name: select_channel_pointer_fifth
description: Chooses a destination pointer and a small code value from global flags and a counter, then calls helper routines.

name: select_channel_pointer_sixth
description: Chooses a destination pointer and a small code value from global flags and a counter, then calls helper routines.

name: initialize_channel_record
description: Calls a routine, stores values into fields of a record including the constant 200, sets a global state to 1, and stores the register argument in a global.

name: dispatch_channel_flag_by_index
description: Stores a global index value in a record field, then sets a status flag depending on whether the index is 4, 3 or another value. It calls helper routines for the flag update.

name: clear_channel_flag_by_index
description: Clears one of three global flags chosen by index 3, 2 or another value, sets a companion flag, then returns.

name: clear_flag_pair_by_index
description: Clears one of two global flags chosen by index and sets a companion flag, then clears a status global.

name: reset_global_flags
description: Clears one global flag to zero, sets a second global to one and clears a status global.

name: call_two_routines_clear_status
description: Calls two routines and then clears a status global.

name: dispatch_by_status_value
description: Reads a status value from its argument and sets one of several globals depending on whether it is 4, 3 or another value, then clears a status global.

name: clear_flag_by_status_value
description: Sets one global to zero for value 3, another for value 2 or a third otherwise, then sets a flag and stores three values into a record.

name: store_record_fields_clear_flag
description: Clears one global, sets a record flag to one, stores four more fields from its arguments and zeroes an eighth field of the record.

name: store_record_fields_zero_flag
description: Sets a record flag to one, stores four fields from its arguments and zeroes an eighth field of the record.

name: store_regs_to_block
description: Stores several data and address register values into a block pointed to by the argument, writing 1 to the first word and 0 to the last one.

name: select_audio_channel_base
description: Chooses an audio channel's hardware register base from the channel index, checks that channel's busy flag in a global, and returns the base for the update.

name: set_audio_channel_data
description: Checks the busy flag of the audio channel selected by index and, when the channel is free, writes volume and period data from a structure to that channel's hardware registers.

name: reset_state_block_first
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: reset_state_block_second
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: reset_state_block_third
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: reset_state_block_fourth
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: reset_state_block_fifth
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: reset_state_block_sixth
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: reset_state_block_seventh
description: Stores the register argument in a global, then zeroes a 136-byte block of global data and performs a further setup step.

name: clear_block_save_restore_byte
description: Zeroes a block of global words and calls helper routines chosen by a selector value.

name: advance_state_machine_step
description: Returns early when a status global is set. Otherwise it dispatches on a status value, incrementing a counter in one case, and calls helper routines in the others.

name: dispatch_status_by_index
description: Dispatches on a register index of 4, 3 or 2 and clears the matching global status. It calls helper routines in each case and returns.

name: set_channel_enable_flag
description: Sets a global channel-enable flag to one and calls another routine.

name: reset_channel_state_flags
description: Calls a routine, then clears several channel-state globals depending on which status flags are set.

name: clear_channel_enable_flag
description: Sets a global channel-enable flag to zero and calls another routine.

name: set_flag_then_run_helpers
description: Sets a global flag to one and calls another routine that performs further work.

name: set_channel_enable_flag_second
description: Sets a global channel-enable flag to one and calls another routine.

name: disable_channel_one_state
description: Calls a helper, loads a value from a global table into a variable, and clears a global counter and flag, disabling that channel's state.

name: clear_channel_enable_flag_second
description: Sets a global channel-enable flag to zero and calls another routine, then returns.

name: set_channel_flag_and_process
description: Sets a global flag to one and calls another routine, which in turn makes several further calls.

name: set_channel_enable_flag_third
description: Sets a global channel-enable flag to one and calls another routine.

name: disable_channel_two_state
description: Calls a helper, loads a value from a second global table into a variable, and clears a global counter and flag, disabling the second channel's state.

name: clear_channel_enable_flag_third
description: Sets a global channel-enable flag to zero and calls another routine that updates related control fields, then returns.

name: set_channel_flag_and_update
description: Sets a global flag to one and calls a routine that updates control fields for the channel, then returns.

name: set_channel_enable_flag_fourth
description: Sets a global flag to one and calls another routine, then returns.

name: disable_channel_three_state
description: Calls a helper, loads a value from a global table into a variable, and clears a global counter and flag, disabling that channel's state.

name: clear_channel_enable_flag_fifth
description: Sets a global flag to zero and calls a routine that updates control fields, then returns.

name: set_channel_enable_flag_sixth
description: Sets a global flag to one and calls another routine, then returns.

name: advance_channel_sequence_step
description: Runs one step of a channel sequence. When the step counter is zero it reads the next 16-bit command from the sequence and returns at a zero entry; otherwise it advances the counter. It stores the command in two channel fields.

name: load_next_sequence_command
description: Reads a 16-bit command from the sequence list and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and a length in channel fields and moves the list pointer forward.

name: step_sequence_with_offset
description: Reads a 16-bit command from the sequence, adjusting the read position when a flag is set. It stores the command and length in channel fields and advances the list pointer.

name: read_indirect_sequence_entry
description: Selects a sequence pointer from one of two stored references, reads a 16-bit command from it, and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: read_sequence_after_decrement
description: Decrements a counter in the channel, reads the next 16-bit command from the sequence and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: clear_bit_and_read_sequence
description: Clears bit 1 of a global flag byte and reads the next 16-bit command from the sequence, returning at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: set_bit_and_read_sequence
description: Sets bit 1 of a global flag byte and reads the next 16-bit command from the sequence, returning at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: load_sequence_pair_and_read
description: Loads a sequence pointer and a short count from the channel, reads the next 16-bit command and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: read_pointer_table_entry
description: Reads the next sequence pointer from a table in the channel, then reads a 16-bit command from it and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: store_sequence_pointer_fields
description: Stores a sequence pointer and its first word into channel fields, then reads the next command and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length.

name: store_pair_and_read_entry
description: Stores two 32-bit values from the sequence into channel fields, then reads the next 16-bit command and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: store_triple_and_read_entry
description: Stores three 32-bit values from the sequence into channel fields, then reads the next 16-bit command and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: reset_counter_and_read_entry
description: Clears a channel counter, reads the next 16-bit command from the sequence and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.

name: clear_count_and_read_entry
description: Clears a channel count field, reads the next 16-bit command from the sequence and returns at a zero entry. Otherwise it stores the command and length in channel fields.
